cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wipe the tyres. Rain is the exception, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow it's Jo on the counter. She'll put it back outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write 'Bicycle admitted in rain.' Initial it for Jo.

reason: A3 exchanges cleaning work for the conditional rule; A5 turns the staff change into a portable signed precedent, without announcing rank.
